entities.name: Francisca Josefa de la Concepción
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisca Josefa de la Concepción Tunja (1671–1742) was a Spanish Neogranadine nun and mystic in the region of New Kingdom of Granada which later became Colombia. The first recorded woman writer of what now is Colombia, her devotional and autobiographical writings were published posthumously.
